Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring health carrier enrollee cards to reflect the copayment amount.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to health carrier enrollee cards; and adding a newsection to chapter 48.43 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: After December 31, 2006, a health carrier that issues a cardidentifying a person as an enrollee must include the amount of anycopayment that can be required of the enrollee upon the card.
